statements.status_notes: GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx requires the non-default pgx simple protocol to be enabled. Harbor configures pgx via a standard DSN in src/common/dao/pgsql.go and never sets PreferSimpleProtocol or QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol, so the extended protocol (prepared statements) is always used and the dollar-quote placeholder confusion cannot occur.
